tast: Add parameterized test support to ListTests GTest supports value-parameterized test suites with the INSTANTIATE_TEST_SUITE_P macro [1]. When listing tests with --gtest_list_tests, the output contains the test's parameterized value [2]. For example, ./dawn_end2end_tests --gtest_list_tests VulkanImageWrappingValidationTests. SuccessfulImport/Vulkan # GetParam() = 1 MissingTextureDescriptor/Vulkan # GetParam() = 1 ... If we simply pass the entire line with the parameterization to --gtest_filter, the corresponding test is not found. This CL strips the parameterization from --gtest_list_tests output. [1] https://github.com/google/googletest/blob/master/googletest/include/gtest/gtest-param-test.h [2] https://github.com/google/googletest/blob/master/googletest/src/gtest.cc#L5593 BUG=chromium:993457 TEST=verified that it works when running dawn_end2end_tests Change-Id: I107941693c7ebc5f2d74908084ecffba731c998d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1758599 Tested-by: Brian Ho <hob@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Brian Ho <hob@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org>

sys-boot/grub: fix grub boot failure on newer EFI based x86 systems Newer Intel SoC's supporting the S0ix feature require the 8254 to be power gated. This causes grub to hang on these systems when they attempt to use it to calibrate the tsc. Applying the fix from upstream, patch was retrieved from https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/grub.git/commit/?id=446794de8da4329ea532cbee4ca877bcafd0e534 On efi systems, make pmtimer based tsc calibration the default over the pit. FROMLIST: bluetooth: xbox controller bug fix The current L2CAP implementation does not change any options if the other side respons with "unknown options", but does if "unaccepted options" is the answer. It is up to the implementation to decide on the effort spent on config negotiations, therefore the current implementation is correct at this point - but many devices (like Xbox One S controllers) are not useable this way. A workaround for many users therefore is to disable_ertm, since this is often the option which is unknown. I would prefer to try it again with altered options instead of globally disable ERTM. In result, I suggest the following patch. It simply adds a new case (L2CAP_CONF_UNKNOWN), which does nothing but falling through to L2CAP_CONF_UNACCEPT.
